text:
sasha: Morning async — quick GPU fleet check. What I did: pushed the prewarm config for the new gpt-mid rollout to staging, validated batch size heuristics, ran a small smoke that hit AMS and SFO lanes. Blockers: APAC quota still pending (ticket #INC-4121), we only have ~30% of requested p4d for the canary window. Also seeing higher KV-cache mem churn in the 8k runs. Today: ask for a quick quota bump in ap-southeast1, can someone +1 and confirm fallback lane mapping if quota not approved? Also planning a short drain test on a small node pool at 14:00 UTC.

dan: I can ping infra-ops and AWS side for the ap-southeast1 quota. I bumped the request (req-7892) last night but it needs manager approval. @mira — can you escalate? I'll add the fallback tag `fallback=ams,sfo` on the router so we don't route to apac if capacity drops. :thumbsup:

mira: On it. Escalated to cloud-quotas with note referencing INC-4121 and req-7892. ETA from them usually 2–4h but might be faster if we call. If it helps, what's the minimal capacity we need for the canary? Also can we tighten the canary to 10% traffic to reduce quota needs?

sasha: Minimal for canary = 6 gpus (2 nodes) in ap-southeast1 for the first 30m, ideally 12 gpus for a safer window. We can reduce to 10% traffic, will update the rollout config in PR #1567. Planning to flip to 10% and keep autoscale min=2 while queuing the rest to fallback. Also adding a quick test to measure KV-cache churn — pushing a small script.

lee: I set a temporary headroom in AMS: +8 gpus for 2h from now. Command I ran:
```
# infra cli
infra capacity bump --region ams1 --pool prewarm --gpus 8 --ttl 120
```
If quota in APAC fails, router will fallback to AMS and SFO. Cost note: 8 GPUs for 2h ~ estimated $520 (on our reserved pricing).

infra-bot: deploy-job/infra-cli: capacity bump request executed by lee (job id job-4422). Monitoring metrics will appear under /dashboards/capacity/overview in ~60s.

dan: FYI I added a snippet to the router config to prefer local region but fallback after 30s of queueing:
`route_policy: prefer_local_then_fallback(timeout_ms=30000)`
I'll open a tiny PR to add tests for the policy behavior.

sasha: Thanks all. Mira — once quotas are confirmed, please drop the approval here and I'll roll the 10% canary at 13:30 UTC. Lee — thanks for the AMS bump, that should keep user-facing latency stable while we wait. Dan — tag me on the PR.

mira: Quota team replied — they increased soft limit to allow 10 gpus immediately, hard limit review still in progress. I'll paste the approval email in the ticket. For now we have just enough for the minimal canary.

sasha: Great. I'll proceed with 10% canary at 13:30 UTC and watch latency/err rates. If we see >2% error or token latency >1200ms, I'll rollback. Kicking off KV-cache churn probe now.

lee: If you need a quick manual scale, ping me and I can add another +4 to AMS briefly.

sasha: Will do. Thanks everyone, will post a short follow-up once the canary is live and metrics look green. :rocket:
